draft:
**Scaled Agile at Enterprise Depth**

Our methodology is informed by large-scale agile transformation, not just project-level sprint practices. At a European aerospace firm, we guided a 600-person engineering department through a SAFe adoption across 8 Agile Release Trains, reducing cycle time by 35%.

**Capability Uplift by Design**

We believe delivery is only half the value — the other half is leaving the organisation more capable than we found it. In the aerospace engagement, 4 embedded Agile Coaches ran a 12-week certification programme, graduating 72 Product Owners and Scrum Masters who continue to sustain the model today.

**Adapted to Your Context**

We will tailor the scaling framework to your organisational structure and maturity. Our approach begins with a two-week discovery sprint to assess current state before recommending the right cadence and governance model.
